rejects.event: Hakata Gion Yamakasa origin dates back when founder Enni had people carry him around.
rejects.quote: Hakata Gion Yamakasa is the most famous festival in Fukuoka and the origin of it is believed to date back to 1241, when Enni, the founder of Jotenji temple, had people carry him around the town on a platform while praying against the plague and eventually eliminated it.
